challenges.name: menu-cache-stampede
challenges.title: Protect the menu cache from stampedes
challenges.description: At 11:30 the cached menu of Rice Rocket's busiest restaurant expired and 800 requests went to PostgreSQL at the same moment; p99 latency jumped to 3 s. Earlier fixes made it worse in other ways: every menu loaded at startup expired in the same second an hour later, and a price change was sometimes followed by a minute of old prices. The editor holds `Main.java`, the cache layer's callbacks, with its key blocks missing, each marked by a `// [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that: a fresh copy is a hit; a copy past its refresh time is served while one background load refreshes it; a request for a menu that is already loading waits for that load instead of starting another; each copy expires after 60 s plus a per-key jitter of up to 6 s, with refresh starting 10 s earlier; and a price change is committed before the cached menu is dropped. Run replays request bursts and price changes on a timeline and counts database loads.
hints: Follow one menu through time: what happens to the requests that arrive during the 200 ms a load takes, at the moment a copy reaches its refresh time, and in the instant between dropping the cached menu and committing the new price?

Look at the order of the checks in onRequest (fresh, refresh window, a running load), at how onLoaded computes expiresAt and refreshAt, and at the order of `db.updatePrice` and `cache.evict` in onPriceChange.

A product page cache in Spring with Caffeine does the same with `Caffeine.newBuilder().refreshAfterWrite(Duration.ofSeconds(50)).expireAfterWrite(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).buildAsync(loader)`: concurrent misses share one future, a copy older than 50 s is served while it reloads, and writes call `cache.synchronous().invalidate(id)` after the transaction commits.

tests.name: 200 requests hit a cold menu at once: one database load, the rest wait for it
tests.expected:
requests: 200 (hit 0, stale 0, wait 199, load 1)
database loads: 1, at most 1 at once
loads started in the busiest second after the first 30 s: 0
old price served more than 1 s after a change: 0

tests.name: Steady traffic for 130 s: the menu is refreshed ahead of expiry, nobody waits after warm-up
tests.expected:
requests: 1300 (hit 1294, stale 4, wait 1, load 1)
database loads: 3, at most 1 at once
loads started in the busiest second after the first 30 s: 1
old price served more than 1 s after a change: 0

tests.name: 50 menus loaded together do not all reload in the same second
tests.expected:
requests: 6500 (hit 6350, stale 100, wait 0, load 50)
database loads: 150, at most 50 at once
loads started in the busiest second after the first 30 s: 19
old price served more than 1 s after a change: 0

tests.name: A price change mid-traffic: the new price is served within a second
tests.expected:
requests: 1001 (hit 995, stale 2, wait 2, load 2)
database loads: 3, at most 1 at once
loads started in the busiest second after the first 30 s: 1
old price served more than 1 s after a change: 0

tests.name: Two cold menus at once: one load each
tests.expected:
requests: 600 (hit 200, stale 0, wait 398, load 2)
database loads: 2, at most 2 at once
loads started in the busiest second after the first 30 s: 0
old price served more than 1 s after a change: 0
